response.justification: Bogdan brings genuine geospatial domain experience (founder of GISCollective, Green Map GIS work, FOSS4G speaker) and has done low-latency systems programming in DLang at scale, which partially transfers to this role. However, his professional C++ experience is limited to a brief stint in 2014–2015, he has no Rust experience, and his recent career (2020–present) is centered on TypeScript/Node full-stack product work rather than systems engineering. He also lacks direct routing/navigation pipeline experience, making him a stretch for a role where modern C++ and navigation guidance solutions are core requirements.
strengths: Long-standing geospatial data experience via GISCollective and Green Map GIS applications
Low-latency, high-throughput systems work in DLang (async I/O, fibers, caching) at Sociomantic
Broad polyglot background with strong Linux, Docker/Kubernetes, and CI/CD practices
concerns: Minimal modern C++ experience (brief role ending 2015) and no Rust exposure
No experience building routing engines, routing tiles, or navigation guidance systems
Recent roles focus on TypeScript/web product work, far from systems-level pipeline engineering
